sermon.title: Restoration's Unlimited Amount Part 1
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: Zechariah saw Jerusalem measured—a picture of the church, too large to wall in, protected by God as a wall of fire. The people gather to Jesus, not denominations. We must change, confess our sins and let the Spirit bear fruit, trusting God to deliver.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

chunks.short_answer: Jerusalem is the church—unwalled, beyond count like the sand; built on her ruins.
chunks.text:

Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls. When he got done measuring it, his description was this is a growing city. Can’t have walls where there’s it just keeps growing, keeps expanding, keeps extending its borders for the multitude of people that are in the church, in the kingdom of God. But God knows them all. God has the number. And just like the sand of the seashore keeps increasing and the stars now the scientists found out is still increasing. More stars are being made. You see, all of these terminologies God gave us so we could understand what he was doing.

chunks.short_answer: God as a wall of fire around her—like Elijah’s servant seeing chariots of fire.
chunks.text:
A wall of fire. You see the church is growing and increasing. The wall of fire just keeps spreading out. So he is our protector to save us from our enemies. He himself is our protection. We remember the prophet in 2 Kings 6:15. They were in a city there, a little town, and him and his servant. And the army came encompassed the city with horses and chariots. And the prophet Elijah’s servant looked out and said, “Oh my gosh, Elijah, what are we going to do?” And Elijah answered and said, “Don’t be afraid, boy. There are more with us than there be with them.” Now, can you imagine this this servant boy, this young guy trying to learn how to be a prophet and by by being around a prophet, he looks out there and he sees thousands of soldiers all around, chariots all around this city.

And he looks and there’s two of them. He goes, “Man, this prophet, he’s he’s he’s losing it.” And then Elisha said, “What? Lord, open the boy’s eyes so he can really see spiritual things.” And God opened the boy’s eyes. And what did he see? Chariots of fire. All around that city between them and the and the army is chariots of fire of God. That army could be there, but they weren’t going to do anything to Elijah because God himself was a wall around Elijah. Church, are you there? Is God the same yesterday, today, and forever? Then will he be that wall of fire for us?

Yes. And these opponents that come to destroy Elijah and his servant outnumbered. Elijah said, “Lord, smite this army with blindness.” God smote him with blindness and he led him to the king of Israel. Hallelujah. Captured a whole army. Two boys, two men. Well, one man and of a and a servant captured a whole army. Folks, can God do a big thing in our generation? Yeah, we got to get this thinking right. You got to be careful living your life by the news and living your life by the statistics that are going on. God is bigger than the news and he’s bigger than statistics. Can I hear an amen? How many want your eyes opened?

Yeah, we need to see spiritual things. All right. Now, Zechariah goes on to say, “The Lord will be the glory in the midst of her.” Now, who’s her? The church. The glory. The Lord will be the glory. Now remember there in the first couple of verses, the messenger that was talking to Zachchariah went to another angel and another messenger and came back with this first person terminology. The Lord. The Lord. The Lord. So who was that second angel? The Lord. Duh. Hallelujah. The Lord Jesus, the one who’s given all power in heaven and authority in heaven and in earth.

chunks.section_question: Whom shall the people gather to?
chunks.short_answer: Jesus—not a denomination; He has power over principalities.
chunks.text:
Power over the church, power over the principalities and powers of darkness, power over the civil governments of the earth, power over the nations, and power over your life. Okay? So, the Lord, the messenger said, the Lord will be the glory in the midst of her now, let’s look at how we can recognize the glory. The hour has come. Jesus said in John 12:23 that the son of man shall be glorified or honored talking about his death, burial, and resurrection. In John 13:27 and verse 31, Satan entered into Judas. Then said Jesus, “What you’re going to do, do quickly.” And so Judas went out to betray Christ. As we all know the story. Then Jesus after Judas left said, “Now is the Son of Man glorified and honored.” And see Jesus that night was taken captive and died the next day.

His honor, his glory was in his death, burial, and resurrection. Hallelujah. And see, Zachchariah told us of this stuff way before it happened. Genesis 49:10, the scepter, the rod of authority, rod of government, rod of leadership, shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet until Shiloh, the Messiah, Jesus, comes, and unto him shall the gathering of the people be. We’re not supposed to be gathering around great book authors today. We’re not supposed to be coming to hear some great speakers. We’re not supposed to be coming for any other reason than for who?

Jesus Christ. Unto him shall the gathering of the people be. It’s not my denomination. It’s not some great leader. It’s not some book author or some music group. The church should be focused on one thing when we come to church and that is who? Jesus Christ. Because out of him comes everything. You find Jesus, you found everything. Amen. You need physical healing, he’s the healer. You need saved from sin, he’s the savior. You need understanding of the word, he’s the one that opens the understanding of the word. Everything is in him. Amen. And this was prophesied and Zechariah just picked up the same tone of prophecy that has been going on since the world began.

Now in verse six, he says, “Come from the land of the north and the four winds from which I’ve scattered you.” He says, “Come. Come to where? Jerusalem, the church. Now, we know, as I said before, there are six million Jews that went to Israel, but there are two billion people out of every kindred tribe, tongue, and nation today that claim to be a Christian in one form or another. Now, that’s a multitude. Amen. Two billion over two billion of the earth claim to be a Christian. I know a lot of you say, “Well, you know, some of Well, at least they’re claiming.”.

Yeah. Now, so that’s about onethird. That’s about onethird of the population. In fact, it is just about exactly one-third. Zechariah 13:9, I will bring the what? Third part through the fire. scriptures.text_nkjv: “Up, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.”
If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

chunks.section_question: Why not be bumfuzzled by wickedness?
chunks.short_answer: God prophesied it and will deliver us; ask Jesus to save; the Spirit bears fruit.
chunks.text:
And so don’t be bumfuzzled because wickedness is abounding. God prophesied it. He told us that was going to happen. People want to go to hell. They want to have pleasure here for a season in sin and the price is hell and they don’t care until they get there. Then they like the rich man in hell wished that change they wish made a better decision. Huh? But it’s too late then. But save yourself from this corrupt generation. So and then he tell he told them how to save yourself. What is it? Say it. Repent. Same word. And be what? Baptized. Water baptized. Everyone, how many of us? Everyone. Ain’t no church can rise up and say there’s another way. There’s no other way. This is it. We got to admit we’re wrong.

We got to repent from that wrong. Turn from it, forsake it, give it up. We got to get water baptized. How many have been waterbaptized? Okay, we got that part down. In the name of Jesus for the forgiveness of your sins. So he’ll forgive us and he will deliver us and you will receive the gift of the Holy Ghost. For the promise is unto you to your children and those that are far off as many as believe and as many as the Lord our God shall call. So what’s the promise? The promise is unto you. He will what? Save you, deliver you, set you free from your trouble, your calamity, your problem, your captivity.

He will do it. It’s not in theory. It is a fact. If he doesn’t deliver us, then he’s a worthless God. Yeah, we might as well be serving idols who are worthless. The second thing is he forgives. The promise he would forgive. He would render your record zero. Forgiveness is it never happened. Hallelujah. I like that one. Nothing’s on my record. When I ask Christ to forgive me, it’s blotted out. There’s nothing there. Not even a You know how you erase a pencil writing and there’s still something there? Man, when he blotss out, it’s nothing there. You can’t even see where something was written. And you’ll receive the gift of what?

The Holy Spirit. Now, some people, they want to be saved and they want forgiveness, but they don’t want this Holy Ghost. But the promise is all three. To you, to your offspring, and to as many as serve Christ and come to him a far off. Are we a far off from this time that this scripture was written? Is the promise Yes. To us? Is all three to us? Yeah. Then how do we get these things? By repenting, admitting we’re wrong, and turning from those wrongs. When we come to church, we’re supposed to have three things. We’re supposed to be a house of prayer. We’re supposed to pray. We’re supposed to worship and praise him. The second thing because we need him and when he comes or his Holy Spirit comes they have power to do things.

All right. Jesus is the savior. You don’t ask the Holy Ghost to save you. You asked who? Jesus to save you. That’s his ministry. The Holy Ghost will convict you of sin, righteousness, and the judgment to come. When you need convincing of things, who do you go to? The Holy Ghost. But Jesus also opens the understanding. So some of their ministries what? Cross over. You never worship the Holy Ghost. Nowhere in the Bible do you find people worshiping the Holy Ghost. You worship who? Jesus. See, you need to know who they are and what they do so you know how to use each aspect of the triune part of God. Hallelujah. See, what’s one of the ministries of God?

No man comes to Jesus except the Father draws them. You see, nobody can separate God from Jesus because God is going to bring you to Jesus. You say, “Well, I don’t I don’t serve Jesus, but I serve God.” You can’t because the father will bring you to Jesus. Right. Amen. See, when you know the understanding of the threepart God, you know why you’re talking to the part that you’re talking to and why you need the part that you need. Then you get the understanding and you also get the results. Hallelujah. The Holy Ghost has nine gifts of the spirit. Word of wisdom, word of knowledge, faith, discerning of spirits, prophecy, miracles, healings, tongues, and interpretation. The Holy Spirit also has nine fruits of the spirit.

Love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, kindness, meekness, faith, and temperance. If you want to mature, who do you need working in your life? The Holy Ghost. You want to be fruitful, you need what? The Holy Ghost. Expressing these fruits in your life. The Holy Ghost is important. Church, Jesus is important and certainly the father is important. We don’t come to church for a social gathering. We come to church to him and we come to church to be used of him so he can save people and mature people and cause people to grow.

faqs.question: Who do you ask to save you?
